about_the_game:
A sex-positive, free-roam Visual Novel that includes a light strategic layer — hiring talent, managing clients, and handling day-to-day decisions — alongside a card-based dating minigame that explores flirtation, rejection, and chemistry in a playful way.

You and your long-time crush team up to launch a startup that combines a Rent-a-Partner service with a Camgirl Agency. It’s an unconventional business, but one rooted in trust, ambition, and the drive to build something real — even if it gets messy.

As you grow your team, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories, boundaries, and goals. You’ll juggle client satisfaction, business decisions, and personal relationships, all while learning how to balance emotional connection with financial reality.

Explore intimacy, identity, and the hustle of navigating the modern sex work industry — all through a blend of storytelling, strategy, and connection!

  • ROMANCE, a number of colorful characters to fall in love with!

  • ENJOY, over 85 sex scenes, featuring animated illustrations!

  • COLLECT, the card-system features Rarities, Binders, and an Economy System!

  • CUSTOMIZE, the wardrobe system lets you dress up your favorite characters!

content_descriptors.notes:
Sugar Service involves explicit sexual content and revolves around camgirls, escorts, and the sex work industry. There are also strong themes of voyeurism, exhibitionism, and consensual free use and there are no depictions of non-consensual sex or sexual abuse. The game includes a growing list of fetishes which are toggleable by the player.

Some character storylines do include talks of other types of abuse and trauma but they are only mentioned as part of character's story and are never visually portrayed.
